Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_00958] Default value for DTC "aging counter up" if aging is not al-
lowed
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the element
DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.aging
does not exist and the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
DiagnosticEdrDat-
aProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticEdrDat-
aProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT
, the DM shall
set the respective
extended data record
value to ’0’.
⌋

allowed

RS_Diag_04190
⌈

DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.aging
does not exist and the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
DiagnosticEdrDat-
aProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticEdrDat-
aProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT
, the DM
shall set the respective
extended data record
value to
DiagnosticAging.
threshold
if configured or ’255’ otherwise.

[SWS_DM_CONSTR_00960] No support for
DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT_FIRST_ACTIVE
⌈
DiagnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
set to
DEM_AGINGCTR_UPCNT_FIRST_ACTIVE

DiagnosticExtended-

[SWS_DM_00961] Configuration of a DTCs significance as extended data record
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticE-
drDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_SIGNIFICANCE
, the DM
shall set the value of this
internal data element
to the DTCs significance as-
signed by
DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.significance
for this DTC and map
it:
• "0" =
occurence
.
• "1" =
fault
.
The length of this
internal DiagnosticDataElement
is one byte.
